name: Sub-Store
desc: Optional subscription manager; manual synchronization only. No scheduled task.

http:
  mitm:
    - sub.store
  script:
    - match: ^https?:\/\/sub\.store\/((download)|api\/(preview|sync|(utils\/node-info)))
      name: sub-store-1
      type: request
      require-body: true
      max-size: -1
      timeout: 900
    - match: ^https?:\/\/sub\.store(?=\/|$)
      name: sub-store-0
      type: request
      require-body: true
      max-size: -1
      timeout: 900

script-providers:
  sub-store-0:
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sub-store-org/Sub-Store/d26e713e38901e02565a6505c1ae5cb8bb8a1a22/sub-store-0.min.js
    interval: 86400

  sub-store-1:
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sub-store-org/Sub-Store/d26e713e38901e02565a6505c1ae5cb8bb8a1a22/sub-store-1.min.js
    interval: 86400
